title: Core/shell molecularly imprinted nanoparticles: optimized synthesis and application in QCM-D biosensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18310-18323
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02297E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mariacristina Gagliardi, Marco Cecchini
Core/shell molecularly imprinted nanoparticles (CS-MI-NPs) are synthesized for biosensing applications. The study highlights their high selectivity and reduced non-specific binding, positioning CS-MI-NPs as effective probes for biosensing tasks.
